description: This file implements a sticker cache system for Telegram, including functions for loading, saving, searching, and describing stickers using vision APIs.

methods.name: loadCache
methods.description: Loads the sticker cache from a JSON file, handling versioning.

methods.name: saveCache
methods.description: Saves the sticker cache to a JSON file.

methods.name: getCachedSticker
methods.description: Retrieves a cached sticker by its unique ID.

methods.name: cacheSticker
methods.description: Adds or updates a sticker in the cache.

methods.name: searchStickers
methods.description: Searches cached stickers by a text query with fuzzy matching.

methods.name: getCacheStats
methods.description: Provides statistics about the sticker cache.

methods.name: describeStickerImage
methods.description: Uses vision APIs to generate a description of a sticker image.
